title: Next encoded word
statement: For a Boolean-valued nondeterministic Turing machine $N$ and natural numbers $d,c,A,a$, define a transformation on Boolean lists $q$ as follows: pair-encode the first decoded component of $q$ with the second decoded component after deleting its first $3$ times the length of the second decoded component of the first decoded component of $q$ entries.
